name: lang-ext
description: A browser extension that helps you learn Persian/Farsi by identifying and explaining Arabic root words and their derivatives as you browse the web.

scripts.lint: eslint content/ utils/ options/ popup/ background/
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --fix content/ utils/ options/ popup/ background/
scripts.security:full: npm run lint && npm run security
scripts.firefox: cp manifest.json manifest-v3.json 2>/dev/null || true && cp manifest-v2.json manifest.json && echo '✅ Switched to Firefox (Manifest V2)'
scripts.chrome: cp manifest-v3.json manifest.json && echo '✅ Switched to Chrome (Manifest V3)'
